name: US median home sale price ($)
description: Median sales price of new houses sold.

migration.note: v1 showed the quarterly median price of new houses sold (FRED MSPUS). The Bureau's flat file of new home sales, which the M16 reader can read, holds the monthly median, a different quantity that would take a new key; the quarterly figure is in a workbook of another shape (an .xls), which no reader reads yet.
